### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is. (e.g., "I want to be able to...")

### Describe the Solution You'd Like
A clear and concise description of what feature, rule setting, or workflow you would like added.

### Describe Alternatives You've Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered or tested.

### Use Case & Store Scenario
How would this feature help store owners and increase WooCommerce conversions? Please provide an example campaign (e.g., "Buy any 3 t-shirts, get 1 cap at 30% off").

### Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or references here.
